title: Claimant Identity Verification Fact Sheet: Payments, Weekly Certification and Open Cases
content:
The same payment and case settings apply on every Claimant Identity Verification pathway.

| Pathway | Benefit payments on the linked claim held until the case is verified | Weeks certified while the case was pending paid once verified, if otherwise payable | Claimant must keep certifying weekly while the case is pending | Verification cases that may be open on one claim at a time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) | yes | yes | yes | 1 |
| Video Trusted Referee Session | yes | yes | yes | 1 |
| In-Person Proofing — American Job Center | yes | yes | yes | 1 |
| In-Person Proofing — USPS Retail Location | yes | yes | yes | 1 |
| Documentary Verification by Mail | yes | yes | yes | 1 |
| Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification | yes | yes | yes | 1 |

## In plain terms

- **Payments wait for verification.** On every pathway, benefit payments on the claim linked to the case are held until the case is verified.
- **Certified weeks are not lost.** On every pathway, weeks the claimant certified while the case was pending are paid once the case is verified, provided they are otherwise payable.
- **Certifying continues.** On every pathway, the claimant must keep certifying each week while the case is pending.
- **One case at a time.** No more than 1 identity verification case may be open on a single claim at any one time, whatever the pathway.
